NoteNarrate is an independent fork based on the open-source SimpMusic project by Tuan Minh Nguyen Duc (maxrave-dev). It adds AI song interpretation and expressive voice narration.

Original source code: https://github.com/maxrave-dev/SimpMusic

Google API keys in both legacy and authorization formats are accepted. If gemini-3.8-flash reaches your project quota, try gemini-3.5-flash-lite. This changes the text model only; Gemini TTS stays unchanged.
